UpdateAgent.ChangeMintsNextVersionOrNoOp.source:
({ before, after, command }) => {
			const name = command.changes.name === undefined ? before.agent.name : command.changes.name
			const modelId =
				command.changes.model === undefined ? before.agent.model_id : command.changes.model.id
			const hasSystem =
				command.changes.system === undefined
					? before.agent.has_system
					: command.changes.system !== null
			const system =
				command.changes.system === undefined ? before.agent.system : (command.changes.system ?? "")
			const hasDescription =
				command.changes.description === undefined
					? before.agent.has_description
					: command.changes.description !== null
			const description =
				command.changes.description === undefined
					? before.agent.description
					: (command.changes.description ?? "")
			const mcpServers =
				command.changes.mcp_servers === undefined
					? before.agent.mcp_servers
					: command.changes.mcp_servers
			const tools = command.changes.tools === undefined ? before.agent.tools : command.changes.tools
			const unchanged = [
				name === before.agent.name,
				modelId === before.agent.model_id,
				hasSystem === before.agent.has_system,
				system === before.agent.system,
				hasDescription === before.agent.has_description,
				description === before.agent.description,
				mcpServers === before.agent.mcp_servers,
				tools === before.agent.tools,
			].every((same) => same)
			return [
				before.agent.status === "active",
				after.agent.status === "active",
				[
					[
						unchanged,
						after.agent.version === before.agent.version,
						after.agent.current_version_id === before.agent.current_version_id,
					].every((ok) => ok),
					[
						!unchanged,
						after.agent.version === before.agent.version + 1,
						after.agent.current_version_id === command.next_version_id,
						after.agent.name === name,
						after.agent.model_id === modelId,
						after.agent.has_system === hasSystem,
						after.agent.system === system,
						after.agent.has_description === hasDescription,
						after.agent.description === description,
						after.agent.mcp_servers === mcpServers,
						after.agent.tools === tools,
					].every((ok) => ok),
				].some((ok) => ok),
			].every((ok) => ok)
		}

({ before, after }) =>
			before.status === after.status ||
			after.status === "pending" ||
			(((after.status !== "allowed" && after.status !== "denied") ||
				before.awaits === "confirmation") &&
				(after.status !== "returned" || before.awaits === "result"))

CreateAgent.NewAgentKeepsItsDeclaredTool.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			before.agent.status !== "" || after.agent.tools === (command.tools ?? NO_AGENT_TOOLS)

RequestToolAction.ARequestWaitsInItsOwnT.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before.call.status !== "" ||
			after.call.status === "" ||
			(before.session._tag === "Running" &&
				after.session._tag === "Running" &&
				after.call.turn === before.session.turn &&
				after.session.awaiting_calls === before.session.awaiting_calls + 1)

ConfirmTool.OnlyAPendingCallOfTheRunning.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before.call.status === "pending" &&
			before.call.awaits === "confirmation" &&
			before.session._tag === "Running" &&
			before.call.turn === before.session.turn &&
			(after.call.status === "allowed" || after.call.status === "denied")

ReturnCustomToolResult.OnlyAPendingCallO.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before.call.status === "pending" &&
			before.call.awaits === "result" &&
			before.session._tag === "Running" &&
			before.call.turn === before.session.turn &&
			after.call.status === "returned"

Session.AnInterruptedTurnNeitherWaitsNor.source:
({ before, events }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			!before.interrupted ||
			events.every((event) => event._tag !== "turn.awaiting" && event._tag !== "turn.continued")

Session.AnInterruptedTurnStaysInterrupte.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			!before.interrupted ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.interrupted

Session.ADeadlineAbandonsOnlyItsOwnSegme.source:
({ before, command, events }) =>
			command._tag !== "AbandonTurn" ||
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			events.length === 0 ||
			(command.segment ?? 1) ===
				(before.open_model_request_id === null && !before.paused
					? before.model_requests_started + 1
					: before.model_requests_started)

Session.AnEndedTurnStartsTheQueuedOne.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			before.pending_user_messages === 0 ||
			after._tag !== "Idle" ||
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "session.status_idle" ||
					(event.stop_reason.type !== "end_turn" &&
						event.stop_reason.type !== "retries_exhausted" &&
						event.stop_reason.type !== "interrupted"),
			)

Session.AStopNamesTheUnansweredCalls.source:
({ before, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					(event._tag !== "session.status_idle" && event._tag !== "session.status_terminated") ||
					event.event_ids === (before._tag === "Running" ? before.awaiting_ids : NO_TOOL_USE_IDS),
			)

OpenAutomationSession.FirstTurnAdmission.source:
({ command, events }) =>
			events.some(
				(event) =>
					event._tag === "session.created" &&
					event.mcp_server_credentials === command.mcp_server_credentials,
			)

MemoryStore.NamedExactlyWhenCreated.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[s.status === "", s.name === "", s.description === "", s.memory_count === 0].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
				[s.status !== "", s.name !== ""].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

MemoryStore.OnlyAnActiveStoreChangesWhat.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "active",
				[
					after.name === before.name,
					after.description === before.description,
					after.memory_count === before.memory_count,
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[before.status === "", after.status === "active", after.memory_count === 0].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

MemoryStore.CountMovesByAtMostOne.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				after.memory_count === before.memory_count,
				after.memory_count === before.memory_count + 1,
				after.memory_count === before.memory_count - 1,
			].some((ok) => ok)

Memory.PlacedExactlyWhenWritten.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[
					s.status === "",
					s.memory_store_id === "",
					s.path === "",
					s.content_sha256 === "",
					s.version === 0,
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[s.status !== "", s.memory_store_id !== "", s.path !== "", s.version >= 1].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Memory.AMemoryNeverLeavesItsPlace.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				[after.memory_store_id === before.memory_store_id, after.path === before.path].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Memory.VersionGrowsByOneOrNotAtAll.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				[after.version === before.version, after.status === before.status].every((ok) => ok),
				after.version === before.version + 1,
			].some((ok) => ok)

WriteMemory.AWriteLeavesTheMemoryPresent.source:
({ after, command }) =>
			[
				after.memory.status === "present",
				after.memory.memory_store_id === command.memory_store_id,
				after.memory.path === command.path,
				after.memory.content_sha256 === command.content_sha256,
			].every((ok) => ok)

WriteMemory.ANewMemoryCountsOnceAndWithi.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				after.store.memory_count ===
					before.store.memory_count + (before.memory.status === "present" ? 0 : 1),
				after.store.memory_count <= MAX_MEMORIES_PER_STORE,
			].every((ok) => ok)

DeleteMemory.ADeleteRemovesOnePresentMem.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.store.status === "active",
				before.memory.status === "present",
				after.memory.status === "deleted",
				after.store.memory_count === before.store.memory_count - 1,
			].every((ok) => ok)

Checkfu.AStoreCountsItsPresentMemories.source:
(m) =>
			m.MemoryStore.every(
				(store) =>
					store.state.status === "" ||
					store.state.status === "deleted" ||
					store.state.memory_count ===
						m.Memory.filter(
							(memory) =>
								memory.state.status === "present" && memory.state.memory_store_id === store.id,
						).length,
			)

Checkfu.TheIndexListsEachStoresPresentMe.source:
(m) =>
			[
				m.MemoryIndex.every((index) =>
					index.state.entries.every((entry) =>
						m.Memory.some((memory) =>
							[
								memory.id === entry.id,
								memory.state.status === "present",
								memory.state.memory_store_id === index.id,
								memory.state.path === entry.path,
								memory.state.content_sha256 === entry.content_sha256,
							].every((ok) => ok),
						),
					),
				),
				m.Memory.every(
					(memory) =>
						memory.state.status !== "present" ||
						m.MemoryIndex.some(
							(index) =>
								index.id === memory.state.memory_store_id &&
								index.state.entries.some((entry) => entry.id === memory.id),
						),
				),
			].every((ok) => ok)

Checkfu.APresentMemoryIsInAStoreThatWasC.source:
({ memory, store }) =>
				[
					memory.state.status !== "present",
					memory.state.memory_store_id !== store.id,
					store.state.status !== "",
				].some((ok) => ok)

MemoryStore.TheLayoutChangesExactlyWhenT.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				[
					after.memory_count === before.memory_count,
					after.layout_version === before.layout_version,
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					after.memory_count !== before.memory_count,
					after.layout_version === before.layout_version + 1,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

WriteMemory.ANewPathCommitsOnlyAtTheLayo.source:
({ before, command }) =>
			[
				before.memory.status === "present",
				before.store.layout_version === command.layout_version,
			].some((ok) => ok)

Session.InitialMessagesAreBoundedAndOnly.source:
(s) =>
			s._tag !== "Idle" ||
			s.initial_messages_remaining === undefined ||
			(s.turn === 0 &&
				s.initial_messages_remaining >= 0 &&
				s.initial_messages_remaining <= MAX_SESSION_INITIAL_EVENTS)

Session.OnlyTheNextInitialMessageCanAdva.source:
({ before, command, events }) =>
			command._tag !== "RecordInitialMessage" ||
			events.length === 0 ||
			(before._tag === "Idle" && before.initial_messages_remaining === command.remaining)

Session.OnlyTheLastInitialMessageStartsT.source:
({ before, command, events }) =>
			command._tag !== "RecordInitialMessage" ||
			!events.some((e) => e._tag === "session.status_running") ||
			(before._tag === "Idle" && before.initial_messages_remaining === 1)

AdmitSessionWithMessages.OnlyActiveAgent.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before.agent.status === "active" &&
			before.environment.status === "active" &&
			before.session._tag === "Uninitialized" &&
			after.session._tag === "Idle" &&
			after.session.turn === 0

AdmitSessionWithMessages.AdmissionLeaves.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				after.agent.status === before.agent.status,
				after.agent.version === before.agent.version,
				after.agent.current_version_id === before.agent.current_version_id,
				after.agent.name === before.agent.name,
				after.agent.model_id === before.agent.model_id,
				after.agent.has_system === before.agent.has_system,
				after.agent.system === before.agent.system,
				after.agent.has_description === before.agent.has_description,
				after.agent.description === before.agent.description,
				after.environment.status === before.environment.status,
				after.environment.version === before.environment.version,
				after.environment.name === before.environment.name,
			].every((ok) => ok)

AdmitSessionWithMessages.AdmissionKeepsT.source:
({ command, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event.initial_messages !== undefined &&
					event.initial_messages.count === command.initial_messages.count &&
					event.initial_messages.messages === command.initial_messages.messages,
			)

Agent.ConfigurationIsStableWithinAVersio.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				after.version !== before.version,
				[
					after.current_version_id === before.current_version_id,
					after.name === before.name,
					after.model_id === before.model_id,
					after.has_system === before.has_system,
					after.system === before.system,
					after.has_description === before.has_description,
					after.description === before.description,
					after.mcp_servers === before.mcp_servers,
					after.tools === before.tools,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)
